contractCorrection: Corrected alpha MAE from full-canvas averaging to the foreground alpha>0.05 union required by the user-approved plan, before any production candidate was evaluated. ROI coordinates and all numeric thresholds are unchanged. Previous hash 28805b97cab4479e27b3cae26e270bc0720b2736e529e413a11d2c4813403ee2 identifies the superseded instrument-calibration specification, not production acceptance.

reference.orientation: front-facing face and body, no registration or rescaling

roiConvention: Pixel rectangles [left, top, right-exclusive, bottom-exclusive] on the fixed reference canvas; L/R is anatomical, opposite viewer side. Frozen from visual inspection of the locked mother image, before any candidate measurements. Never shrink after a failed result.

regions.label: Complete head hair and braid context
All skirt petals, checked underskirt and lace

ssim.input: Float64 straight sRGB RGB alpha-composited over each fixed background, range 0..1
ssim.mask: Union of reference alpha>0.05 and candidate alpha>0.05, intersected with each fixed ROI; no candidate-dependent removal of differing pixels
ssim.aggregation: Compute a full-canvas SSIM map for RGB, average channels per pixel, then mean over masked pixels. Border pixels use the library reflected Gaussian boundary. Require global and every ROI on every background.

alpha.scope: IoU uses the full fixed canvas at alpha>=0.5. Alpha MAE uses only the union of reference alpha>0.05 or candidate alpha>0.05. Per-ROI alpha diagnostics do not introduce additional thresholds.
alpha.mae: Mean absolute difference of alpha/255 over the same foreground union used for masked SSIM; transparent padding never dilutes this mean

deltaE00.implementation: skimage.color.rgb2lab and deltaE_ciede2000, D65/2-degree default observer
deltaE00.input: Unpremultiplied sRGB RGB, reference-fixed solid material regions. Candidate alpha never removes selected pixels.
deltaE00.scope: Require each fixed material region and their union; report candidate alpha coverage for diagnostics. Percentile uses numpy linear interpolation.

manualChecksNotReplacedByMetrics: Both eye decorations remain the original two-stroke ivory plus inside brown embroidered eyes; no eyelashes in any expression.
Original eyebrows, nose and mouth retain their shape and placement; closed eyes are clean arcs and hide the plus completely.
Face and body remain fully front-facing in neutral; the scarf covers the neck across approved motion extremes.
Hair, cloth, lace, boots and leather preserve coherent material direction and have no repeated or smeared patch defects.
Layer ownership is correct, with no duplicated eye, hair, tool or garment pixels attached to another moving part.
Hidden repaint covers actual pose extremes without holes, popping, incorrect draw order or exposed seams.
Real Cubism model, motion and browser runtime acceptance are separate from this image comparison.
